description: Individual opponent candidates for future slot-based team assembly; not yet wired into the battle bot.

sets.set:
Vaporeon @ Assault Vest
Ability: Water Absorb
EVs: 252 HP / 128 Def / 128 SpD
Modest Nature
- Flamethrower
- Scald
- Thunderbolt
- Shadow Ball
sets.notes: Water Absorb is Vaporeon's normal ability. All four attacks are permitted by Assault Vest; coverage is expanded through the custom format.

sets.set:
Zapdos @ Assault Vest
Ability: Pressure
EVs: 252 HP / 128 Def / 128 SpD
Modest Nature
- Thunderbolt
- Heat Wave
- Signal Beam
- Scald
sets.notes: Bulky special coverage ace: Zapdos is a non-restricted legendary. Scald is made available through custom move legality. Not optimized for maximum damage.

sets.set:
Regirock @ Leftovers
Ability: Multiscale
EVs: 252 HP / 128 Def / 128 SpD
Impish Nature
- Electroweb
- Toxic Spikes
- Power-Up Punch
- Stealth Rock
sets.notes: Electroweb is the speed-lowering Electric attack; Stealth Rock is the Rock-type entry hazard. Multiscale rewards keeping Regirock at full health. Mainly useful in singles; in doubles the hazards have reduced impact.

sets.set:
Regice @ Icy Rock
Ability: Snow Warning
EVs: 252 HP / 128 Def / 128 SpA
Modest Nature
- Blizzard
- Freeze-Dry
- Thunderbolt
- Protect
sets.notes: Snow Warning automatically summons hail in Gen 7; Icy Rock lengthens it. Blizzard is accurate in hail but the weather can chip non-Ice allies, so no automatic weather synergy is added.

sets.set:
Registeel @ Rocky Helmet
Ability: Levitate
EVs: 252 HP / 128 Def / 128 SpD
Careful Nature
- Iron Head
- Thunder Wave
- Seismic Toss
- Protect
sets.notes: Levitate removes Registeel's Ground weakness and can incidentally complement allied Earthquake users. Consistent utility but low offensive pressure.

sets.set:
Regigigas @ Sitrus Berry
Ability: Regenerator
EVs: 252 HP / 128 Def / 128 SpD
Careful Nature
- U-turn
- Volt Switch
- Parting Shot
- Dragon Tail
sets.notes: Three moves switch Regigigas out; Dragon Tail instead forces the target to switch and is therefore not a self-pivot move. Regenerator heals when leaving battle. Not a high-damage sweeper. No Parental Bond or Poison Heal.

sets.set:
Gengar @ Focus Sash
Ability: Cursed Body
EVs: 4 HP / 252 SpA / 252 Spe
Timid Nature
- Dazzling Gleam
- Thunderbolt
- Shadow Ball
- Dark Pulse
sets.notes: All four moves are obtainable by Gengar in Gen 7. Focus Sash provides one chance to survive from full HP; Dark Pulse overlaps Shadow Ball somewhat but preserves the user-specified unconventional coverage set.

sets.set:
Tentacruel @ Leftovers
Ability: Liquid Ooze
EVs: 252 HP / 128 Def / 128 SpD
Calm Nature
- Toxic
- Protect
- Scald
- Substitute
sets.notes: Gen 7 legal four-move defensive build. Stronger in Singles than Doubles because Toxic and Substitute consume tempo; traditional Poison typing, Leftovers recovery, and chance to burn via Scald.

sets.set:
Garchomp @ Rocky Helmet
Ability: Rough Skin
EVs: 252 HP / 128 Def / 128 SpD
Impish Nature
- Earthquake
- Dragon Tail
- Stealth Rock
- Protect
sets.notes: Rough Skin and Rocky Helmet punish contact; defensive rather than maximizing Attack. Stealth Rock and Dragon Tail are more Singles-oriented, so keep the role tagged for future format weights.

sets.set:
Ninetales @ Wise Glasses
Ability: Flash Fire
EVs: 4 HP / 252 SpA / 252 Spe
Timid Nature
- Thunderbolt
- Flamethrower
- Ice Beam
- Scald
sets.notes: Four-element attacking coverage; Thunderbolt and Scald are custom move access. Wise Glasses boosts special attacks without Choice lock.

sets.set:
Ninetales-Alola @ Wise Glasses
Ability: Snow Warning
EVs: 4 HP / 252 SpA / 252 Spe
Timid Nature
- Thunderbolt
- Flamethrower
- Ice Beam
- Scald
sets.notes: Four-element special coverage with Snow Warning hail, which does not automatically complement all partner Pokémon. Flamethrower and Scald are custom move access. The set can incidentally hurt friendly non-Ice partners with hail.

sets.set:
Mimikyu @ Power Herb
Ability: Disguise
EVs: 4 HP / 252 SpA / 252 Spe
Timid Nature
- Geomancy
- Draining Kiss
- Dazzling Gleam
- Shadow Ball
sets.notes: Geomancy + Power Herb provides one-turn +2 Special Attack, Special Defense and Speed in Gen 7, while Disguise offers a setup opportunity. Low base Special Attack (50) intentionally tempers the potential; verify Gen 7 BH move restrictions in live validator.
